definitions.explanation: small pieces of paper with a re-adherable adhesive strip on the back, used for marking pages, leaving messages, or organizing information

examples.japanese: {付箋紙|ふせんし}にメモを{書|か}いた。
examples.english: I wrote a note on a sticky note.

examples.japanese: {大事|だいじ}なページに{付箋紙|ふせんし}を{貼|は}っておく。
examples.english: I stick a note on important pages.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}で{色|いろ}とりどりの{付箋紙|ふせんし}を{使|つか}ってアイデアを{整理|せいり}した。
examples.english: We used colorful sticky notes to organize ideas during the meeting.

notes:
Combines {付箋|ふせん} (tag, label, sticky note) and {紙|し} (paper). In everyday conversation, {付箋|ふせん} alone is more commonly used, but {付箋紙|ふせんし} is the more precise term found on product packaging and in formal contexts. The brand name ポスト・イット (Post-it) is also widely recognized.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {付箋紙|ふせんし}を{貼|は}る: to stick a note
- {付箋紙|ふせんし}を{剥|は}がす: to peel off a sticky note
- {付箋紙|ふせんし}に{書|か}く: to write on a sticky note
- {色|いろ}{付|つ}き{付箋紙|ふせんし}: colored sticky notes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {付箋|ふせん}: sticky note — the shorter, more casual version of the same word
- メモ{用紙|ようし}: memo pad — writing paper for notes without adhesive
- {見出|みだ}しシール: index tab — tab-shaped labels for dividing sections
